ariaLabel: Open help: Recycle Bin soft-deleted records

sections.heading: What this is
bullets: The Recycle Bin lists employees and assets that were soft-deleted from the app. Records stay here until someone restores them; they do not disappear on a timer.
Each row shows the item type, what was deleted (first name or model / id), when it was deleted, and who deleted it (first name / employee code when available).

sections.heading: Admin and IT Ops
bullets: Restore puts the record back into normal use. Use Refresh to reload the list after changes.
If you do not see the Recycle Bin in navigation, your account does not have access.
